# House paper specs

## Text stocks
- House uncoated: 100 gsm, FSC mix.
- House silk: 150 gsm, twin-wire.

## Cover boards
- House cover: 300 gsm, one-side cast coated.

## Ordering
- Anything below 80 gsm goes to the mill on special order.
